5. A complete set of Bidding Documents may be purchased by interested Bidders on
September 21-October 15, 2018 from the address below and upon payment of a
nonrefundable fee for the Bidding Documents in the amount of Four Hundred (P 400.00)
Pesos.
Office of the Municipal Treasurer
Municipal Building, Mueda St.
Miagao, Iloilo
It may also be downloaded free of charge from the website of the Philippine
Government Electronic Procurement System (PhilGEPS) and the website of the
Municipality of Miagao (www.miagao.gov.ph), provided that Bidders shall pay the
nonrefundable fee for the Bidding Documents not later than the submission of their
bids.
6.
The Municipality of Miagao will hold a Pre-Bid Conference on October 1, 2018 at
10:00 a.m. at the Conference Room of the Municipal Building, Mueda St., Miagao, Iloilo
which will be open only to prospective bidders.
7.
Bids must be duly received by the BAC Secretariat at the address below on or before
October 15, 2018 at 9:30 a.m. All Bids must be accompanied by a bid security in any
of the acceptable forms and in the amount stated in ITB Clause 18.
Office of the Municipal Mayor
Municipal Building, Mueda St.
Miagao, Iloilo
Bid opening shall be on October 15, 2018 at 10:00 a.m. at the Conference Room of the
Municipal Building, Miagao, Iloilo. Bids will be opened in the presence of the Bidders
representatives who choose to attend at the address below. Late bids shall not be
accepted.
Conference Room
Municipal Building, Mueda St.
Miagao, Iloilo
